000762.SZ.longBusinessSummary: Xizang Mineral Development Co. LTD engages in mining business. The company explores for chromite, copper, lithium, and boron deposits. It also offers lithium batteries that are used in information products, cameras, electric vehicles, and civil power peak-shaving power supplies. The company serves atomic energy, aerospace, and metallurgical industries. The company was formerly known as Tibet Mineral Development Co. Ltd. Xizang Mineral Development Co. LTD was founded in 1994 and is based in Lhasa, China.

000768.SZ.longBusinessSummary: AVIC Xi'an Aircraft Industry Group Company Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, sells, maintains, and services military aircraft and military and civilian aviation parts in China. It provides large and medium-sized military transport aircrafts, bombers, and special purpose aircrafts. It also offers development of key components such as fuselages and wings for the C909, C919, AG600, and MA series aircraft, as well as manufactures wings and fuselages for the Airbus A320/A321 series aircraft, and vertical tail and inboard flaps for the Boeing B737 series aircraft. In addition, the company offers aviation engineering technical support, customer service, technical information, user training, and aircraft parts support. The company was formerly known as AVIC Aircraft Co., Ltd. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Xi'an, China.

000776.SZ.longBusinessSummary: GF Securities Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides capital market services in China. It operates through four segments: Investment Banking, Wealth Management, Trading and Institution, and Investment Management. The company offers equity and debt financing, financial consulting, and mergers and acquisitions; and brokerage services, investment advisory, margin financing, securities lending, and various financial products. It also provides equity sales and trading, derivative and fixed-income products, OTC liquidity services, investment research, and custodian services; and asset and fund management, private equity, and alternative investments, as well as qualified foreign and domestic institutional investors. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.

000785.SZ.longBusinessSummary: Easyhome New Retail Group Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates and manages chain stores in China. It operates in five segments: Leasing and Franchising Business; Decoration; Merchandise Sales; Financial; and Other. The company offers home furnishing store operation, leasing, management, and franchising services; home decoration services, such as personalized customization, mansion design, whole decoration packages, and partial renovation, etc.; financing, guarantee, and factoring services; AI design tools; digital solutions and precision marketing services, including live broadcasting, studio photography, and AIGC for home furnishing merchants; and other services. It also sells home building products; decoration and department store supplies; and electronic products, such as smart wearable devices, phones, robots, operating systems, and life service platforms, as well as engages in investment management, property leasing, small loan, software technology development, and wholesale and retail activities. In addition, the company operates digital platforms, such as Juran Designer, Juran Smart Home, and Dongwo; and a vocational skills training school focused on training home service, customized home furnishing, and smart home service technicians. Further, it owns, leases, and franchises shopping malls and modern department stores under Zhongshang World brand; and general, campus, and micro supermarkets. Easyhome New Retail Group Corporation Limited was founded in 1990 and is based in Beijing, China.

000786.SZ.longBusinessSummary: Beijing New Building Materials Public Limited Company, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells building materials in China. It operates through Light Building Material, Water-Proof Building Material, and Coatings and Building Material divisions. The company offers gypsum board products, such as fire-resistant, water-resistant, formaldehyde-removal, anti-cracking and anti-sagging, perforated, and phase-change gypsum boards; multifunctional, mineral wool, and fiber cement boards; light steel and T-grid studs; internal and exterior paintings; joint compound gypsum, binders, leveling putty, putty powder, and self-leveling gypsum; insulating materials, such as rock wool board and felt, and granulated wool; waterproof materials; flooring products, including commercial heterogeneous vinyl sheets, special and sports flooring, vinyl planks, homogeneous vinyl flooring, and ninyl composition tiles; and ceiling and partition accessories, as well as special tools, keels, and architectural and industrial coatings. It also provides interior wall systems, such as ordinary partition, fire- and water-resistant, sound absorption, CH stud shaft, and veneer wall systems; standard, functional, and decorative ceiling systems; and exterior wall systems. In addition, the company engages in the manufacturing and sale of mortar, architectural hardware, and paint; import and export of building materials; wastewater treatment; environmental protection technology consulting; waterproofing construction; and new material technology promotion services. Its products are used in public buildings, home decorations, renovation, subway tunnels, and industrial buildings. Beijing New Building Materials Public Limited Company was founded in 1979 and is based in Beijing, China.

000792.SZ.longBusinessSummary: Qinghai Salt Lake Industry Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells potash fertilizers in China and internationally. It operates through four segments: Potassium Products, Lithium Products, Trading, and Other. The company offers chemical raw materials and chemical products; potassium chloride and other potassium products; lithium carbonate; and fertilizers. It also operates hotels and department stores; and provides labor services. Qinghai Salt Lake Industry Co.,Ltd was founded in 1958 and is based in Golmud, China.

000795.SZ.longBusinessSummary: Innuovo Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, production, sale, import, and export of rare earth permanent magnet materials in China and internationally. The company also engages in motor manufacturing, such as alternating current motors, permanent magnet, DC motors, brushless, steppers, servo motors, electric push rod actuators, parallel shafts, worm gears, and planetary gear reducers, as well as motor drives and mobility scooters. In addition, it offers gearboxes, electrical machinery equipment, general and special equipment, communication equipment, computers, and other electronic equipment; and electric wheelchairs. Further, the company is involved in clean energy generation, as well as the production and sales of solar and wind generation devices, complete sets devices. Additionally, it offers sales of power-assisted bicycles, scooters, and spare parts; engages in private equity investment, investment management, and investment consulting; and NdFeB magnetic materials. Its products are widely used in electroacoustics, wind power generation, smart home appliances, traction machines, industrial motors, automobiles, speakers, air-conditioning compressors, mobile terminals, and industrial motors, as well as health travel, gardening and agricultural machinery, special home appliances, security fields, smart logistics, and other fields. The company was formerly known as Taiyuan Shuangta Ganyu Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Innuovo Technology Co., Ltd. in March 2016. Innuovo Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is based in Jinhua, China.

000801.SZ.longBusinessSummary: Sichuan Jiuzhou Electronic Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and sale of digital audio and video, and data communication terminals in China and internationally. It also provides air traffic control and microwave radio frequency products. In addition, the company offers industrial, commercial, and container energy storage system; AC charging pile; ONT and xDSL products, cable modem, digital TV equipment, TV modular and amplifier, fiber optic transmission equipment, optical components, and WIFI AP products. Sichuan Jiuzhou Electronic Co., Ltd. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Mianyang, China.

000807.SZ.longBusinessSummary: Yunnan Aluminium Co., Ltd. produces and sells aluminum primarily in China. It operates through three segments: Alumina, Primary Aluminum, and Other. The company offers cast aluminum alloy ingots; wrought aluminum and aluminum alloy round ingots; wrought aluminum and aluminum alloy flat castings; aluminum home furnishing; aluminum and aluminum alloy welding materials; aluminum alloy welding wires; and electrician round aluminum rod. It also provides aluminum ingots/refined aluminum ingots for remelting, metallurgical grade alumina, and carbon for aluminum. The company's products are used in electronics, aerospace, transportation, optical, chemical metallurgical, automobile lightweighting, rail transportation, shipbuilding, automotive, architectural decoration, 3C electronics, packaging and printing, power, communications, and machinery industries, as well as in the production of corundum, ceramics, and refractory materials. The company was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Kunming, China.

000825.SZ.longBusinessSummary: Shanxi Taigang Stainless Steel Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sales of steel products in China and internationally. The company's products include stainless steel, cold-rolled silicon steel, carbon steel hot-rolled coils, railway wheel and axle steel, and alloy mold steel; ultra-pure ferritic, duplex steel, tank container, non-magnetic steel, and railway passenger and freight car steel; and high manganese, soft stainless steel precision foil hand-torn steel, pen tip steel, high-nitrogen stainless steel and other products. It also engages in the processes, produces, and sells pig iron, steel ingots, steel billets, stainless-steel products; ferrous metals; metal products; stainless-steel plates; and stainless-steel seamless pipes and welded pipes, as well as trades stainless steel and ferrous metals. In addition, the company provides technical consulting services and bonded warehousing services. Further, its products are used in petroleum, chemical, shipbuilding, container, railway, automotive, urban light rail, and power plants. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Taiyuan, China. Shanxi Taigang Stainless Steel Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Taiyuan Iron & Steel (Group) Co.,Ltd.
